(Nashville, Tennessee) | college = * [[North Florida Ospreys men's basketball|North Florida]] (2020–2024) * [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee]] (2024–present) | highlights = * Third-team [[NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|All-American]] – [[National Association of Basketball Coaches|NABC]], [[Sporting News|SN]] ([[2025 NCAA Men's Basketball All-Americans|2025]]) * [[Jerry West Award]] (2025) * [[Southeastern Conference Men's Basketball Rookie of the Year|SEC Newcomer of the Year]] (2025) * First-team All-[[ASUN Conference|ASUN]] (2024) * Second-team All-[[Southeastern Conference|SEC]] (2025) }} '''Chaz Harrison Lanier''' (born December 19, 2001) is an American [[college basketball]] player for the [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]] of the [[Southeastern Conference]] (SEC). He previously played for the [[North Florida Ospreys men's basketball|North Florida Ospreys]]. == Career == Lanier attended [[The Ensworth School]] in [[Nashville, Tennessee]]. At the conclusion of his high school career, he committed to the [[University of North Florida]] to play for [[North Florida Ospreys men's basketball|North Florida Ospreys]].{{Cite web |title=Ensworth basketball: Chaz Lanier commits to North Florida |url=https://subscribe.tennessean.com/restricted?return=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.tennessean.com%2Fstory%2Fsports%2Fhigh-school%2F2020%2F03%2F25%2Fhigh-school-basketball-recruiting-coronaviirus-chaz-lanier-north-florida%2F2896464001%2F&gps-source=CPROADBLOCKDH&itm_source=roadblock&itm_medium=onsite&itm_campaign=premiumroadblock&gca-cat=p&slug=restricted&redirect=true&offer=W-M7&gnt-eid=control |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=The Tennessean}} In his first three seasons, he played primarily in a backup role.{{Cite web |last=Gillaspie |first=Stephen |title=Chaz Lanier: Staying Down For It |url=https://www.noceilingsnba.com/p/chaz-lanier-staying-down-for-it |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=No Cellings |language=en}} As a senior during the 2023-24 season, he averaged 19.7 points per game and was named to the first team All-[[Atlantic Sun Conference|ASUN]].{{Cite web |title=UNF's Chaz Lanier voted first-team All-ASUN, joins teammate Dorian James on all-academic team |url=https://subscribe.jacksonville.com/restricted?return=https%3A%2F%2Fwww.jacksonville.com%2Fstory%2Fsports%2Fcollege%2Fbasketball%2F2024%2F03%2F04%2Fchaz-lanier-dorian-james-of-unf-basketball-team-cited-in-asun-awards%2F72828373007%2F&gps-source=CPROADBLOCKDH&itm_source=roadblock&itm_medium=onsite&itm_campaign=premiumroadblock&gca-cat=p&slug=restricted&redirect=true&offer=W-M7&gnt-eid=control |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=Jacksonville}} At the conclusion of the season, Lanier entered the [[NCAA transfer portal|transfer portal]].{{Cite web |date=2024-05-18 |title=Report: One of the top guards remaining in the portal is visiting BYU |url=https://www.deseret.com/sports/2024/05/17/chaz-lanier-byu-basketball-visit-report-transfer-portal/ |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=Deseret News |language=en}} On May 24, 2024, he transferred to the [[University of Tennessee]] to play for the [[Tennessee Volunteers basketball|Tennessee Volunteers]].{{Cite web |date=2024-05-24 |title=Vols land sharpshooting guard Lanier from UNF |url=https://www.espn.com/mens-college-basketball/story/_/id/40212293/former-north-florida-guard-chaz-lanier-commits-tennessee |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=ESPN.com |language=en}}{{Cite web |last=Wilson |first=Mike |title=Chaz Lanier commits to Tennessee basketball over Kentucky after big year at North Florida |url=https://www.knoxnews.com/story/sports/college/university-of-tennessee/mens-basketball/2024/05/24/chaz-lanier-tennessee-basketball-transfer-portal-roster-rick-barnes/73267139007/ |website=Knox News}} With Tennessee, he emerged as the team's leading scorer.{{Cite web |last=Sartori |first=John |date=2024-12-24 |title=One-on-one with Tennessee basketball’s Chaz Lanier |url=https://www.wvlt.tv/2024/12/24/one-on-one-with-tennessee-basketballs-chaz-lanier/ |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=WVLT |language=en}} In his first game with Tennessee, Lanier scored a team high 18 points, leading the Volunteers to an 80–64 win over [[Gardner–Webb Runnin' Bulldogs men's basketball|Gardner–Webb]].{{Cite web |last=McGee |first=Trevor |date=2024-11-04 |title=‘I never lost confidence’: Chaz Lanier leads team in scoring in debut game for Tennessee basketball |url=https://www.utdailybeacon.com/sports/mens_basketball/i-never-lost-confidence-chaz-lanier-leads-team-in-scoring-in-debut-game-for-tennessee/article_58bc8b42-9b27-11ef-a477-33cecf8e21ab.html |access-date=2024-12-26 |website=The Daily Beacon |language=en}} Against [[Miami Hurricanes men's basketball|Miami]] in the [[Jimmy V Classic]], he led the Volunteers in scoring with 22 points, in a 75–62 victory.{{Cite web |last=Wilson |first=Mike |title=Chaz Lanier is an A-plus for Tennessee basketball.
